entries.note: Salvatore 2010 (PMID 20065019) abstract has the quote verbatim; rhesus CIDV EC50/EC90 0.8/7 nM. FDA ubrogepant PharmR calls CIDV an 'animal efficacy model', so model_filed=true holds.

Li 2015 (PMC4415719) full text: 'EC50 of ~1.6 nM', EC90 14 nM; quote matches apart from small-caps units. It says CIDV was 'first established and validated in the rhesus monkey', so the pairing is right. Moore 2020 abstract confirms ubrogepant rhesus 3.2 vs human 2.6 nM.

untested is right, but fix fields: Li 2015 shows the MK-3207 dose target came from human healthy-volunteer CIDV PK/PD (EC90 14 nM) calibrated on telcagepant phase 3, not rhesus 7 nM. Set model_kind human_challenge and correct the note.

Quote verbatim in Li 2015. Li predicted 20 mg with a 40-100 mg plateau. Hewitt 2011 added 200 mg for 'insufficient efficacy' at 20-100 mg, and only 200 mg was significant. contra fits that dose-table row. Li says CIs overlap from 10 mg up. model_kind should be human_challenge (see dose 1).
Quote verbatim in the Salvatore 2010 abstract. FDA PharmR (NDA 211765) lists monkey CIDV among 'animal efficacy models' for ubrogepant.

Hewitt 2011 abstract: primary endpoint 2-h pain freedom, and the dose-response trend quote is verbatim. NCT00712725 results were first posted 2010-11-22 (type ESTIMATED). patient_trials quotes for MD-02 (SumR) and rimegepant 75 mg (212728 bundle) are verified. BI 44370 quote not checked.

The Fierce Biotech URL returned 403, so I could not see the quote. Smith 2020 abstract independently confirms MK-3207 was discontinued over DILI concerns. No MK-3207 animal toxicology is public, so untested is reasonable. A citable copy of the 2009 Merck release is needed.

SumR quote verbatim. PharmR quote verbatim: 'no ALT elevations were predicted for any of the protocols tested'. Smith 2020 full text says DILIsym predicted liver safety 'before the clinical trial was conducted', so it is prospective. model_change=true is unneeded (prior entry untested) but harmless.

missing: Smith 2020 (doi 10.1093/toxsci/kfaa093, PMC8312697): 'DILIsym successfully modeled liver toxicity for telcagepant and MK-3207 at the dosing regimens used in clinical trials'. This is a 2020 retrodiction for member MK-3207. The draft mentions it only in a judgement, with no retro entry (see rule question).

BI 44370 discontinuation: secondary reviews (e.g. PMC4392770) attribute it to liver toxicity and/or oral formulation difficulty. No primary source (press release or registry) was found. If confirmed, it is a second member liver signal for the safety cell. At minimum the safety note should mention it.

Ubrogepant dose: Voss 2016 phase 2b (doi 10.1177/0333102416653233) found 1 and 10 mg ineffective and 25/50/100 mg effective. Moore 2020 gives human CIDV EC50 2.6 nM. If a CIDV-based ubrogepant dose prediction exists (e.g. the exposure-response paper 'Making Better Dose Decisions...'), it is a second member's dose comparison. The FDA ClinPharmR bundle has no CIDV dose rationale.
rule_questions: Retrodiction vs prospective on the same model: DILIsym retro-modeled MK-3207 (published 2020) in the same paper that reports the prospective ubrogepant match (2019 FDA, 2020 paper). Should the cell carry a separate retro entry for the MK-3207 member, or does the prospective same subsume it? Decision 10 does not say how a retro and a same of the same date and model order on the strip.

Dose-table row 'reached, failed, a higher dose later worked': does the higher dose have to be shown superior to the predicted dose? For MK-3207, 200 mg alone was significant, but CIs overlapped from 10 mg up, and the same trial met its primary endpoint on a pooled dose-response trend. The table also implies efficacy contra-then-same, while the draft keeps efficacy same because the primary was met in the same trial. Which applies?

Should a dose model built in human healthy volunteers (human CIDV calibrated on a non-member's phase 3 data) count as the same model_id/system as the rhesus CIDV used for engagement and efficacy, given that the brief scopes 'the model' to the preclinical system the class relied on?
